# A focusable node in content handed to a recursion may not depend on the
# slot's arguments on bubbletea, and saying so is a positioned error.
#
# A recursion renders the content once per level, each level passing its own
# argument, while bubbletea gives the content one focus stop and runs its
# handler in Update at the site that wrote it -- where no argument is bound.
# The handler reading `d` was dropped: no stop, no `hits +=`, silently. A
# branch reading it is the same question, since Update walks the branch to find
# the node. A prop reading it is fine: it is rendered where `d` is bound.
#
# html keeps each level's handler in the level, so the same program builds.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out handler.sngl
stderr 'handler.sngl:25:59: a focusable node in the "label" content handed to "frame" reads the slot argument "d"'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out2 branch.sngl
stderr 'branch.sngl:25:24: a focusable node in the "label" content handed to "frame" reads the slot argument "d"'

sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out3 prop.sngl
sngl generate --platform html --out out4 handler.sngl

# A focusable node in the recursion's own body is further still: Tab and
# Update reach only the stops the window renders, so its focus state was
# declared nowhere and the Model did not compile (`undefined: __focusID`).
# The button is the platform's primitive by then, so the position is the
# declaration's.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out5 own.sngl
stderr 'own.sngl:5:1: the recursive component "frame" renders a focusable node in its own body'
sngl generate --platform html --out out6 own.sngl

-- handler.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, label component(depth int) node) node {
    vbox {
        label(n)
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component label(d) {
                    label(d)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

var hits = 0
var xs = [1, 2]

window {
    vbox {
        text(value="hits {hits}")
        for var x = xs {
            frame(n=x) {
                component label(d) {
                    button(text="b {d}", @click { hits += d })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- branch.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, label component(depth int) node) node {
    vbox {
        label(n)
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component label(d) {
                    label(d)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

var hits = 0
var xs = [1, 2]

window {
    vbox {
        text(value="hits {hits}")
        for var x = xs {
            frame(n=x) {
                component label(d) {
                    if d > 0 {
                        button(text="b", @click { hits += x })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- prop.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, label component(depth int) node) node {
    vbox {
        label(n)
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component label(d) {
                    label(d)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

var hits = 0
var xs = [1, 2]

window {
    vbox {
        text(value="hits {hits}")
        for var x = xs {
            frame(n=x) {
                component label(d) {
                    button(text="b {d}", @click { hits += x })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- own.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

var hits = 0

component frame(n int) node {
    vbox {
        button(text="level {n}", @click { hits += n })
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        text(value="hits {hits}")
        frame(n=depth)
    }
}
